title: Dark Leather Jacket on a Parisian Balcony
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight blonde hair and wispy bangs stands on a balcony with ornate black wrought-iron railings. She wears a dark brown leather zip jacket with a high collar, patch pockets, and a short black skirt, with a black shoulder bag strap across her body. Gold rings adorn her fingers. Her expression is calm and serious, looking off to the side. Warm, late-afternoon light on a cream stone facade. Palette of espresso brown, black, and warm gold. Chic and candid, in the style of an urban street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The leather jacket and ornate railing set the mood.
- Keep the stone facade for a Parisian setting.
